findings.description: The cache key ignores the tenant, causing cache collisions between different tenants that use the same record_id.
findings.evidence: Calling lookup(cache, 'a', '1', load) and then lookup(cache, 'b', '1', load) will return the same value and only invoke load once, despite the tenant being different.

review.summary: Candidate implementation does not cache results separately per (tenant, record_id) pair, violating the contract.
